name: InterContinental Vienna
positioning: City-centre hotel overlooking the Stadtpark, moments from the Vienna State Opera and Kaerntner Strasse
best_for: Travelers who want a central base near the Opera and the main shopping streets
Concertgoers heading to the Konzerthaus and Musikverein

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Stadtpark in the heart of Vienna.
The Stadtpark is located opposite the hotel's main entrance.
The hotel is moments away from the Vienna State Opera and shopping on pedestrianised Kaerntner Strasse.
Fashion boutiques on Kaerntner Strasse and Kohlmarkt are a short stroll away.
Concerts at the Vienna Konzerthaus and Musikverein are within easy reach by subway.
Behind its functionalist exterior, the hotel has a wood-panelled lobby hung with chandeliers.
The hotel has a grand ballroom for hosting events.
Cafe Vienna is a Viennese coffee house serving coffee specialties and pastries, with traditional afternoon tea in the afternoon.
The hotel is certified with the Austrian Eco-Label and holds Green Key certification.
Pet dogs are allowed in guest rooms.

highlights.text: Club InterContinental guests enjoy a 180-degree panoramic view over downtown Vienna from the Club Lounge on the 12th floor.
Classic rooms blend traditional and contemporary furnishings and have views of the Stadtpark or the Vienna Concert Hall.
The Stadtpark opposite the hotel has a golden Johann Strauss monument.
The Intermezzo Bar has a polished central bar under an opulent chandelier and serves fine wines, whiskies and cocktails.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
WhataHotel notes the busy city-centre location may bring urban noise.
